item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: Burn ban goes into effect in Bartonville
item.description: A burn ban has been declared in the Village of Bartonville, prohibiting recreational fires and landscape waste until further notice.

item.title: Peoria seeks to dismiss lawsuit against Par-A-Dice Casino plan
item.description: Peoria officials have asked a judge to drop their lawsuit against the owners of the Par-A-Dice Casino Hotel after Boyd Gaming changed their plan to replace the riverboat casino with a barge moored on the river.

item.title: Peoria preparing to open new Fire Station 16
item.description: The City of Peoria is opening a new Fire Station 16, replacing the oldest station in the department, with upgraded alerting and air bottle filling systems, improved health and safety features, and updated living quarters for firefighters.

item.title: ISU police offer guidance on missing person reports
item.description: ISU Police share tips on what to do when someone is missing, including checking locations and collecting information, and encouraging people to contact law enforcement if they are concerned for someone's safety.

item.title: Sorensen delivers Valentine's Day cards to firefighters as part of 'Hearts for Heroes'
item.description: U.S. Rep. Eric Sorensen showed appreciation for first responders and healthcare workers in Peoria by delivering Valentine's Day cards to them as part of his Hearts for Heroes initiative.

item.title: Peoria Children's Home marks 160 years of dedicated service
item.description: The Children's Home Association of Peoria is celebrating its 160th anniversary and is planning a fundraiser to reimagine its spaces and continue to provide services to kids in need.

item.title: What is Presidents Day? Local historians explain
item.description: PEORIA, Ill. (WMBD) -- On Presidents' Day, many people are off of school or work. But why? It all started back in 1885, according to The U.S. National Archives and Records Administration, when President George Washington's birthday, Feb. 22, was deemed a federal holiday. Later on, President Abraham Lincoln was simultaneously honored on the holiday. [...]

item.title: Arson determined to be cause of fire near Fire Station 12
item.description: The Peoria Fire Department responded to an arson fire across the street from Fire Station 12 on Monday, which was extinguished within 30 minutes and determined to be a total loss of the vacant house.

item.title: Soulful Gospel Brunch unites community through music, food and fellowship
item.description: The 18th Annual Soulful Gospel Brunch hosted by the Bloomington-Normal Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Incorporated is a community event that raises money for scholarships, educational development, economic development, and financial literacy webinars.
